provenance.note: Eye-guided from an artist-supplied coarse plain-weave canvas photograph. The weave period, thread thickness variation and colour follow that image; permeability, porosity and tooth height remain unmeasured stand-ins. Primed canvas barely absorbs, so permeability is near zero on purpose - it is not paper.

settings.note: viewGain is a display control only; it does not change physical state.

review.notes: Could we have a default paper and brush that load with each medium change?  So for watercolor-> Rough Watercolor Paper, oil->Linen, charcoal->Pastel White

OL-12.note: Approved as the pickup-and-drag pass; the artist clicked the only row that mentioned picking up.

BR-01.note: Re-judged with the filbert on 2026-08-21 and approved. The earlier mark-down was made with the disc, which is sized in cells and cannot hold a true millimetre size.

BR-02.note: Re-judged with the filbert on 2026-08-21 and approved. The earlier mark-down was made with the disc, which is round and marks the same in every direction.

BR-03.note: Marked down 2026-08-21 while testing with the disc, which cannot demonstrate this. The artist disowned the test; restored to machine-checked, awaiting a judgement made with a drawn brush.

BR-04.note: Set to partial 2026-08-21. The disc can feather, so this judgement stands on its own feet and is left alone.

BR-05.note: Judged with the filbert on 2026-08-21 and left at partial: "Paint runs out very quickly - too quickly, actually." Measured at 42% of a full dip for one 8 cm oil stroke. Reworked the same day - capacity and release are now separate per-brush numbers, reach is roughly 3.7x further, and auto-reload is on by default with an adjustable amount. Awaiting a re-test.

BR-06.note: Re-judged with the filbert on 2026-08-21 and left at partial. Supersedes the earlier disc mark-down; BX-03 "its hair feels right" is partial for the same reason.

engine.BR-05: When paint left on brush hits 0 it stops picking up and scraping paint.
engine.BR-04: What the crap does a head of hair, not a cookie cutter mean?  Anyway, it's not great at feathering edges.  I think it may partially be related to the other item I marked as needing recalibration.  The relationship between the brush and the paint already on the canvas just doesn't quite jive.

provenance.note: ADR-0002 third-material vocabulary test. Every value is an unmeasured normalized stand-in assembled from existing canonical properties; no new property family was introduced. Yield stress, viscosity, packing, density, and transfer efficiency require artist review before any claim of oil realism.
